policy: Frozen source ledgers remain byte-preserved. This overlay defines effective review status, separate corrected variants, and reader-layer provenance without rewriting printed source TeX or treating editorial/research content as PDF source coverage.

MAI-P4-053.note: The printed general-step GD bound uses dimensionful 2k alpha + 1 and 1-alpha terms. The normalized step is alpha L. See MAI-P4-218.

MAI-P4-059.note: The printed alpha=1/L GD bound scales as 1/L, which fails the objective/L scaling check. See MAI-P4-212 for a safe standard bound.

MAI-P4-103.note: The printed odd-N branch simplifies toward zero while the surrounding text claims approximately 2. See MAI-P4-213.

MAI-P4-109.note: Submultiplicativity gives an upper bound on the transformed best Lipschitz constant, not equality in general. See MAI-P4-219.

MAI-P4-111.note: The equality 2/L_grad_f = 2/(||P|| L_grad_Psi) inherits the loose equality in MAI-P4-109. See MAI-P4-220 for the conservative sufficient step-size condition.

MAI-P4-133.note: Convergence of the weighted distance to an arbitrarily chosen minimizer requires additional uniqueness/strong-convexity assumptions. See MAI-P4-214 for Fejer monotonicity.

MAI-P4-154.note: Strict beta>0 fails at the standard t^(0)=1 initialization, where beta^(0)=0. See MAI-P4-215.

MAI-P4-156.note: The printed recurrence references h_{n,n}, outside the coefficient row defined through n-1. See MAI-P4-216.

MAI-P4-170.note: The printed upper bound conflicts with the standard Nesterov recurrence initialized at t^(0)=1. See MAI-P4-217.

corrections.articleSection: Adversarial review correction — GD bound scaling
corrections.note: Safe standard L-smooth convex GD upper bound; this does not claim the exact PEP constant.

corrections.articleSection: Adversarial review correction — periodic first difference
corrections.note: For the normal circulant periodic first-difference operator, the odd-N maximum magnitude is 2 cos(pi/(2N)).

corrections.articleSection: Adversarial review correction — PGD Fejer monotonicity
corrections.note: Monotonicity is safe without claiming convergence to zero for every arbitrarily selected minimizer.

corrections.articleSection: Adversarial review correction — FGM initial momentum
corrections.note: The initial momentum coefficient is zero under the standard initialization.

corrections.articleSection: Adversarial review correction — FGM coefficient indexing
corrections.note: The k=n-1 branch references the defined h_{n,n-1} coefficient, matching the row indexing and the analogous OGM recurrence.

corrections.articleSection: Adversarial review correction — Nesterov recurrence bound
corrections.note: The standard recurrence gives a lower bound, not the printed upper bound.

corrections.articleSection: Adversarial review correction — normalized GD step
corrections.note: Dimensionally consistent form using the normalized step h=alpha L for 0<alpha<=1/L.

corrections.articleSection: Adversarial review correction — transformed Lipschitz bound
corrections.note: Submultiplicativity provides a conservative upper bound on the best transformed Lipschitz constant.

corrections.articleSection: Adversarial review correction — conservative transformed step
corrections.note: Using the conservative bound from MAI-P4-219 yields a sufficient fixed-step interval without asserting equality of best constants.
